snippet.title: Aperture Dating Simulator - Steam Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
WE'RE ON STEAM!
Aperture Dating Simulator is officially available to wishlist on the Steam Store. This is a big step and we're incredibly thankful to Valve for allowing us to bring this project to life!

You can search up "Aperture Dating Simulator" on the Steam Store or copy/paste this link to be redirected.
https://store.steampowered.com//app/3723280
